topics.signal: damaged or loose guard/handrail, unsafe tread

topics.signal: charred equipment, exposed conductors or visible arcing

topics.signal: active visible leak, corrosion, water near electrical equipment

topics.signal: unsafe visible vent connector or discharge configuration

topics.signal: disconnected vent or visible soot near combustion appliance

topics.verification: Inspector observations and appropriate specialist tests needed; source imagery alone cannot prove concealed condition or root cause
